# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Path & Connection Puzzles
Games involving drawing or tracing paths, connections, or loops

### A. Loop Formation
- **Closed Loops**: Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Slitherlink
- **Open Paths**: Hashiwokakero, Numberlink, Nagareru
- **Hybrid Path Types**: Masyu

### B. Line Drawing
- **Single Continuous Path**: Hebi, Suraromu
- **Multiple Path Elements**: Pencils

---

## II. Coloring & Shading Puzzles
Games involving marking or coloring cells according to constraints

### A. Binary Coloring (Shaded/Unshaded)
- **Constraint-Based Shading**: Akari, Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nuritwin
- **Pattern-Based Shading**: Heyawake, Norinori, Satogaeri
- **Boundary-Based Shading**: Nurimisaki, Sto-stone

### B. Multi-Color or Specific Marking
- **Color Assignment**: Ripple Effect, Tilepaint, Usowan
- **Specific Patterns**: Shakashaka, Yajilin

---

## III. Polyomino & Tiling Puzzles
Games involving dividing grids into shapes or placing polyominoes

### A. Polyomino Placement
- **Specific Polyominoes**: LITS, Shikaku
- **Variable Polyominoes**: Evolomino, Fillomino, Five Cells
- **Domino-Based**: Chained Block, Double Choco

### B. Tetromino Variants
- **Standard Tetrominoes**: LITS
- **Pentominoes**: Evolomino

### C. Irregular Regions
- **Region Division**: Ripple Effect, Sashigane

---

## IV. Number-Based Logic Puzzles
Games using numerical clues and constraints

### A. Sudoku Family
- **Standard Sudoku**: Sudoku
- **Sudoku Variants**: Nansuke

### B. Clue-Driven Puzzles
- **Cell Counting**: Kurotto, Makaro, Moon-or-Sun
- **Region Sums**: Juosan, Yosenabe
- **Distance/Direction Clues**: Yajilin

### C. Numerical Path Puzzles
- **Sequential Numbering**: Numberlink, Nurimeizu

---

## V. Hybrid & Complex Puzzles
Games combining multiple puzzle mechanics

### A. Multi-Mechanic Puzzles
- **Coloring + Paths**: Choco Banana, Norinori
- **Shading + Regions**: Heyawake, Satogaeri
- **Numbers + Shading**: Akari, Kurotto

### B. Constraint-Heavy Puzzles
- **Multiple Overlapping Rules**: Masyu, Slitherlink, Yajilin

---

## VI. Uncategorized/Specialized
Games with unique mechanics not fitting primary categories

- **Unique Mechanics**: Chained Block, Dotchi-Loop, Makaro, Suraromu, Usowan

---

## Alternative Organization: By Primary Mechanic

| **Mechanic** | **Games** |
|---|---|
| **Loop Drawing** | Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Slitherlink, Masyu |
| **Path Tracing** | Hashiwokakero, Numberlink, Nagareru, Hebi, Suraromu |
| **Shading/Coloring** | Akari, Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Heyawake, Norinori, Satogaeri, Nurimisaki, Sto-stone, Shakashaka, Yajilin, Tilepaint, Ripple Effect, Usowan |
| **Polyomino Placement** | LITS, Shikaku, Fillomino, Evolomino, Five Cells, Chained Block, Double Choco |
| **Numerical Constraints** | Sudoku, Nansuke, Kurotto, Makaro, Moon-or-Sun, Juosan, Yosenabe, Nurimeizu |
| **Hybrid Mechanics** | Choco Banana, Pencils, Sashigane, Nuritwin |
